children: Fathom Holdings agreed to explore a restructured transaction that would combine its brokerage and title business with NXH's digital asset portfolio valued at no less than $130 million.
NXH would contribute ~38.8% direct and indirect tZERO stake, Medici fund assets and GrainChain to Fathom.
The contributed digital assets would be ascribed no less than $130 million, subject to Fathom's valuation validation.
NXH would receive newly issued Fathom shares and is expected to retain a controlling interest after the transaction.
Fathom would gain flexibility to pursue acquisitions and integrate blockchain/tokenization use cases for real estate.
Transaction requires definitive agreements, board and stockholder approvals, regulatory clearances and other customary conditions.
